verdict.rationale: Mercury's marketing claims "granular user permissions" and built-in permissions that let roles such as an accountant make payments, which is product-level user access control. Nothing documents how roles are defined or how permissions are scoped across locations or departments. Scoped API tokens concern programmatic access, not team-member roles, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documentation of role definitions and permission granularity, scoping by location or department, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can define granular user roles and permissions across team members, locations, and departments

citations.quote: Curb team spend with card limits, spend controls, and granular user permissions.
Built-in permissions means our accountant can easily make payments
